lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance spots across the lateral flank, organized into distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher intensity pixel data intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-based spatial arrangement on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with light upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of parallel, vertical, dark linear lacerations located on the upper-mid lateral flank, indicated by a graphical arrow.
